name: window-agreed
description: The callee offers to ring back. The caller declines, asks when to call instead, and the callee names a time. This is the happy path the whole app is built around.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Good morning. I'm an automated assistant calling on behalf of Amina Otieno, with her permission. She is an existing patient of Dr Mwangi and I'm calling to book a follow-up.

turns.speaker: callee
turns.text: Right, let me see. What is the earliest appointment you have with Dr Mwangi?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: What is the earliest appointment you have with Dr Mwangi?

turns.speaker: callee
turns.text: Dr Mwangi has Tuesday the fifteenth at half nine, or the Thursday afternoon.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Can you arrange a sign language interpreter for the appointment? The patient is Deaf and communicates in writing.

turns.speaker: callee
turns.text: I would have to check with the coordinator about the interpreter. I can ring you back once I know.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I'm not able to take a call back. When should I call you instead?

turns.speaker: callee
turns.text: Try me tomorrow between ten and twelve, I'll have spoken to her by then.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Thank you, I'll call then. Goodbye.
